name: shared-frame-import-boundary
goal: Keep shared explorer frames independent of entity-specific panels while preserving source-code modal behavior

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Commit 16ab6fdf6 made ExplorerFrame import an archive reader from EntitySource.svelte. At 86529ba6a, the normal composition test proves history reaches that panel; 634 other Reports cases pass.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The focused Source pair omitted the existing composition suite after changing shared-frame imports. Strengthen its general Entity-pane boundary and require that suite in frame-focused commands; normal Reports verification already owns it.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 2ae28d51 at 5dd1dbd5d proves the direct shared-frame pane-import assertion. The original history-separation assertion also fails; archive and modal behavior still pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Move the unchanged archive reader and path selector into the existing source-reader store; preserve the component export. Enforce the general Entity-pane boundary in standard composition coverage and frame-focused acceptance.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Commit bbfd05450 moves the unchanged archive reader and path selector into the existing store, preserves the component export, updates references and indexed contracts, and retains all screen-separation assertions.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged green 13f9e0c7 at bbfd05450 passes one archive, thirteen composition/Source unit and twenty-four responsive browser cases. Matching red is 2ae28d51 at 5dd1dbd5d.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: In an isolated clone, restoring the old Frame import fails the unchanged general pane-boundary guard (exit 1). Restoring the store import passes (exit 0); test SHA remains b9ad26a4f692d0f78d48ca17b3735be06576a947252b19b5813304064039dcff.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
